sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Low spirited, memory weak. Desire to be
alone. Annoyed by visions, causing her to cry. Head
feels too large. Left-sided headache up to eyes and
into ears. Headache worse stooping and lying down.
CEdematous swelling of forehead.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Red, itching, burning and bloated. Eyes
swelled and watery, burn with coryza. Eyes weak, day
and gas light unpleasant.

Mouth, - - The tongue coated white, and shows im-
print of the teeth. Mouth sore and ulcerated.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Sore pain in liver goes through to shoul-
ders and spine. Pain In spleen down to groin. Pain
in breast extends to hip and spleen. Diarrhoea, burning
^tery stools with relief of pain.

"I^ose. — Sixth potency.

sections.label: head
sections.text:
Scalp feels sore even when pulling a single hair.

I Falling off of hair, d Tertiary syphilis. — Lippe.

I 1 As if the head were swollen on waking in the night or morn-
ing, as if he could not get his hat on the head.

Numbness on right occiput, later on left vertex ; evening.

Numbness from the nose to forehead, and in a streak along the
vertex backwards, more to the left.
^ Sight and Eyes. Heaviness in eyes.

Eyes pain, cannot read much.

Upper lid sore and feels swollen.

Lids slightly inflamed and swollen, more with coryza.

Eyes reddened with coryza.

In region of brows numbness, extending to nose.

Glowing sensation on a small spot over left brow.

Sight weak, gas-light troubles him, cannot look into bright
light.

Eyes hurt, cannot read in the morning.

Eyes hurt in afternoon and evening ; << after sewing.

I Her weak eyes improve two weeks after, so that she can use
them, and even bear exertion she could not bear last four
years.

Eyes pain as from walking in the wind.

Headache extends to the eye ; pains from the facial bones, or
go from the eye to back part of ear.

I I Lids cannot be opened as wide as usual.

I I Eyes much swollen, or slightly reddened for two days ; run-
ning of tears, sometimes hot and corroding ; dark circles un-
der the eyes ; coryza.

■ Pterygium, with enlarged blood vessel, right eye; after Nux
and Sjngel. had failed.
® Hearing and Ears. Pain into ears from side of head and facial

bones ; numbness below the ears.
^ SmeH and Nose. Coryza and hoarseness returned in two weeks
with heat in face, lasting three days, and ending in angina
of fauces ; BeUad.*° helped.

On rising in the morning he feels as if he would get a violent
coryza ; nose stopped up ; eyes burn ; hoarse ; gone in the
evening.

129 ARSENICUM METALLICUM.

Coryza with hot face, itching and hoarseness; returns the 21st

day.
Coryza ; burning hot water runs from nose, excoriating the
edges of nostrils ; with the greatest prostration.

Violent coryza ; reddened eyes ; running of tears, and of wa-
ter from nose, excoriating, 11 a.m.; after four hours nose
stopped ; eyes inflamed without discharging tears ; head very
full and as if tied up ; 8 p.m. : nose begins to run again, with
violent sneezing ; throat aches ; breathing difficult, till 11
P.M.; at 4 A.M. : wakens with the same coryza, still worse;
sensation as if head and face were swollen ; some sore throat.

Ooryza lessened after eyes were inflamed ; nose swollen for
several hours, lessened suddenly, but feels as if beaten all
over.

Coryza with running of tears ; sneezing and difficult breathing,
increases 2d day ; discharge, thick, yellow ; eyes swollen and
puffed up ; feels as if head had suddenly become too large,
lasts for days, then ceasing slowly ; watery discharge hot or
warm several times a day, causes biting and stinging; sud-
denly a burning as if scalded.

Pain in nose from headache ; pains in left side in the evening ;
pains from the cheek-bones, with it a fine streaming like
warm air on the left side.

Violent itching in tip of nose, 1 p.m.; evening, more to the
left.
^ Face. Face bloated, red and hot, with coryza.

Itching burning, with swelling, skin feels tense, relieved by
bathing with cold water ; later, followed by peeling off" in
small scales.

(Edematous swelling on forehead and face, with itchino-.

Itching burning, stinging, with swelling on face, most on right
forehead, <C at night, >- by cold washing.

Sensation as if the skin were immovable, tense and stretched
tightly over the bones.

The itching not relieved by scratching, only by pressing and
squeezing.

A few pimples in face, gradually more, until within three
months he has more than a dozen, with it he feels better
than before in every way.

Pain in cheek-bones, when touched it shoots into right eye, into
the nose and below the ear.

Swelling of cheeks.

Itching and burning of lower half of face around lower jaws, as
if an eruption would break out.
^ Lower Part of Face. Pain in lower jaw on right side down
into throat and neck.

Stiff"ness in lower jaws when biting.

Twitching in left lower jaw.

VOL. II. — 9.

ARSENICUM METALLICUM. 130

Painless swelling of lips and right cheek, very disfiguring, last-
ing 36 hours, followed by a much lowered pulse.

Lips dry and hot.
^^ Teeth and Gums. Gums swollen and sore.

Gums swollen and feel as if scalded, with water running to-
gether in mouth.

Gums swollen, pain when touched, as if sore, with the outer
lips dry and hot, first day the right, then the left side.
^^ Tongue. ' l Coating on tongue white, mucous.

BB Tongue bears imprint of teeth.
^^ Inner Mouth. Dry mouth, with white slimy, furred tongue.

I 1 Mouth sore.

Accumulation of water in mouth.

A small white ulcer, size of point of finger inside of left lower
lip, with a pale halo, very painful.

On right and left under lip a sore inside, hurts when touched
with the tongue, also the whole inner edge of lower lip hurts,
next day the same on left lip.
^^ Palate and Throat. Throat sore, more frequently with coryza.

Violently inflamed throat, with pain when swallowing, worse
right side ; after a coryza. Cured by Bellad.

Ulcer deep in throat, right side, painful in swallowing, in-
creases for several days, is worse in forenoon ; 2d to 9th day.

B Angina, with much heat in throat, and several little ulcers,
several weeks after the ulcer of the gland had been healed by
Natr. curb.; after Jod.^'^ it healed.
^* Appetite, Thirst, Desires, Aversions. Diminished appetite ;
3d day.

No appetite for weeks, not until after 3d or 4th month ; his
actual appetite and strength returned.

Great desire for brandy or alcoholic drinks, most in the fore-
noon, with a lady who never used them.

Aversion to wines and alcoholic drinks for several months, with
a man who had not objected to them.

Aggravation after drinking a small quantity of brandy, for
which he had not the slightest desire.
^® Belching, Nausea. Hot eructations as of bile, with throbbing
through whole body, at noon.

Nausea toward morning.

Nausea with the headache, in the morning.
^"^ Stomach. Pressure in region of stomach, first mucus, then bile ;

later empty retching and cutting in belly ; the 3d night,
^^ Hypochondria. Sore pain in region of liver, goes through all
the way to shoulder and spine.

Stitch from region of liver towards the breast bone.

Itching on a small spot, size of point of finger, one inch above
the navel, as if in the liver.

Pain in region of spleen down to the groin, evening.

131 ARSENICUM METALLICUM.

Pain in breast extends to region of spleen.
^^ Abdomen. Bloated abdomen.

When getting awake bellyache, tormenting, cutting, shooting,

followed by a burning, watery stool and cessation of pain.
Tension and sensation of swelling, with heaviness in head and

threatened vertigo.
Pulsation in the navel.

Pulsation in abdomen extending to 1. groin and down to knee.
Colic with retching after vomiting at night.
I I Red rash on abdomen in the night, the following night red

smooth spots.
Painful swelling in right groin ; < on extending the leg, pain

goes up to hip, lasting a long time ; on the same place he

had a suppurating bubo 24 years ago.
^^ Rectum, and Stool. After awaking at 6 A.M., distressing,

lancinating, griping pains in bowels, followed by an acrid,

burning, watery stool, and relief of the pain, but leaving

much debility ; falls asleep sitting ; no appetite ; pulse 60,

much fuller than usual.
Constipated after two weeks.
Some of the patients who received it had two weeks after some

exceedingly painful piles.
Varices bleed a little.
Varices right side of anus painful after stool, not bleeding, a

few days later only sore; disappear the 4th day, after some

bleeding.*
Itching in anus, gets sore after rubbing, intolerable during the

afternoon, extending to perineum and scrotum, obliged to

scratch violently ; the sore feeling is lessened by very hot

water, not by cold washing.
Intense itching at anus, followed by crawling on the end of

the back, mornings.
^^ Urinary Organs. Urine hot in the evening.

Red, sandy sediment in urine.
^^ Male Sexual Organs. Pain in groins, in the morning the

right, evening the left.
Pain when awaking in left groin, extending to the thigh.
Pain from region of spleen to the groin.
Pulsation in the groin.
Itching in groin and down to knee.
In right groin painful swelling, pain extending to the hip ;

<; when stretching the leg, >■ walking ; <C in sitting ; leg

falls asleep ; had a bubo on the same spot.
A numbness extends trom hip-joint to the pubic region.
Itching on glans ; prepuce swollen.

* If piles disappear after bleeding, it is a pathological symptom ; if they
bleed after disappearance, it is therapeutical.

ARSENICUM METALLICUM. 132

Swelling of the prepuce, with slight burning, lasting half a day
and extending to a circumference three times greater ; the
3d week.

Sore place on corona glandis, right side, from where a chancre
had been driven 20 years ago, by mercurial ointment ; now
thin, watery fluid is discharged, causing thg most violent
itching, increasing the sore place ; 2d week ; in the 3d week
a similar excoriation on left side of corona glandis, with
swelling of prepuce and itching on the edges ; three weeks
after its appearance, Mercur.^", without effecting a change ;
in four weeks, Natr. carh?"^ followed by improvement ;
nearly well in five days ; persuaded among friends to take a
little brandy and water, it got worse and remained so for
three days ; after Natr. carh^'^ it disappeared.

iChagicres with 1 1 burning pain. — Lippe.

Offensive sweat on genitals for some weeks'.

Itching on scrotum lasting for weeks.
^^ Female Sexual Organs. With the appearance of the monthly
the pulse usually became less frequent.

Heat in uterus and vagina ; burning when touched.

1 8 Monthly before the time, lasting longer than usual.

Catamenia appeared at 7 a.m., darker, more fluid and more
copious.

On the sixth day passed large lumps of blood-colored mucus.

1 1 Catamenia too early and too scanty. — Lippe.

I Pain in uterus and vagina during the monthly.

■ Able to sew during her monthly, which she never could do
before.
24 Pregnancy. Slight stitches in right mamma, under the shoul-
der-blade ; later, in the left.

Pain in left mamma, behind the nipple ; later, stitch about an
inch behind the nipple, thence extending down to the region
of hip.

Itching on the mammae.
2* Voice and Larynx. I l Hoarseness, with coryza.
^^ Respiration. Hot breath.

Violent difficulties in breathing, with sneezing; coryza; run-
ning of tears ; he had to lie higher with his head ; increas-
ing from 3 P.M. till in the night.

Breathing became painful and asthmatic, and lasted three days
and then somewhat less four more ; very bad before break-
fast ; >• after the 8th day.

As if a heavy load was lying on the chest all night ; dreams
of danger on the water.*
^^ Inner Chest and Lungs. Pain in right side of chest near nip-

* Such dreams always indicate lung or heart symptoms..

133 ARSENICUM METALLICUM.

pie, extending downwards and upwards ; after 30 minutes in
left side, and going to neck ; later, again right side.

At 10 A.M. pain in chest near the nipple, shooting about and
down into region of spleen ; when at the worst it is near the
apex of the heart, with more frequent pulse.

Chilliness extending into chest.

Chilliness in chest, with the headache.
^^ Heart, Pulse and Circulation. Slight pains in region of

sections.label: heart
sections.text:
After mental disturbances, pain in region of heart.

A stitch in the heart.

A single cutting pain through the heart, at 4 p.m.

Pulsation under the sternum.

I Could lie only on left side. ^Disease of heart.
Pulse 64 in the morning ; 4th day.

Pulse continues to rise in mornings, and to fall in the evenings,
for 30 days longer, without taking any more of the medicine.

I I Pulse accelerated in the morning (similar to Sulphur).
Pulse 116 in the morning, and unequal.

^^ Outer Chest. Pain in muscles of left chest.

On left side of chest small blisters filled with blood, which can
be pressed out without pain.

Dull pain in left pectoralis extending to muscles of the shoul-
der and to the point of the shoulder-blade, and through the
lower inner part of the arm down to elbow ; >> by striking
on it, throwing arm back and lifting the shoulder.
^^ Neck. Back. Numbness and sensation of lameness in right
lumbar region, from vertebras to crest of ilium and inner side
of thigh down to the knee.

Lumbago ; fears walking might increase it, but ceases wiien
walking;.

Pain from chest extending into neck.

Pain from region of liver to back and shoulder.

Pain back of right shoulder, morning.

Pain in spine between shoulders, sore to the touch and burning.

Stitch behind the shoulder-blades.

I I Chilliness in the neck, I with headache.

Sensation when lifting the head as if it was drawn down into
the cushion, morning.

Weakness of the neck.

Itching in front of throat.

I I Itching in the neck, I with coryza.

Crawling on the back.

Feels as if a furuncle would form ; 9th day.
^^ Upper Limbs. Pain in shoulders and arms.

Pain in right arm above elbow, mornings ; later, stitches on the
outside of left arm above elbow.

ARSENICUM METALLICUM. 134

After carrying a child, sharp pain in right arm below elbow, as
if wrenched; after resting, as if beaten ; for days.

Arras and hands feel heavy, as if it required more exertion to
lift them.

Sore feeling in left arm below elbow, goes through the hand to
thumb.

Pain in right forearm below elbow, goes through hand into lit-
tle ring finger and is worse in middle joint of the middle
finger.

Cracking of all the finger-joints, more when closing hands.

Cold hands during the day, at other times inwardly hot, or cold
hands with hot body.

Dry heat in palms of hands.

I I Insensibility in forearm and hands.

Hands and fingers feel swollen, cannot close hands.

Hands feel stiff, as if they could not be closed.

Itching on the olecranon.

I A scab on first joint of left third finger, when torn off leaving
a liver-colored spot, a new scab soon forming ; of 20 years
standing.
^^ Lower Limbs. Sensation of lameness in right hip-joint.

i I Pulsation in right hip-joint •< morning, ^ evening.

Pulsation from the heel up to the hips.

Sensation of lameness and numbness in right hip-joint, deep in,
extending to symphysis pubis and on inner side of thigh
down to the knee.

Pulsation in right anterior tibial artery, at the superior end of
its inferior third.

Sensation of dryness in right knee-joint.

Feet burning hot, feel as if bloated, next day the same, with-
out the least moisture.

Feet, usually icy cold, have become warm, and sweat much.

Feet burning, more at night, has to hold them out of bed, can-
not bear the least cover on them ; recurs two weeks after.

From lying on right side, the right hip painfully fatigued, as
if he had been lying on a board.

Lameness in right hip-joint and down the thigh, worse after
rising from a seat ; gets better while continuing to walk.

When bathing pain in left hip so bad that she cannot lift the
limb ; pains from hip to heel.
^* Limbs in General. Feet, hands and fingers feel as if swollen

and stiff.
^° Rest. Position. Motion. Sitting : pain in groin < ; falls
asleep.

Lying head high : coryza better.

Lying left side : heart disease better.

Stretching leg : pain in groin worse.

Walking : pain in groin >> ; lumbago > ; hip better.

135 ARSENICUM METALLICUM.

Striking : pain left pectoralis better.

Stooping : sensation of water gusliing forward in head.

Carrying a child : pain r. arm as if wrenched.

Rising from seat: hip-joint worse.
^^ Nerves. Debility, weariness, general prostration of strength.
^^ Sleep. After an unusually sound sleep at night, irrisistible incli-
nation to sleep in the day time and early in the evening.

Great drowsiness in morning, after rising, having had a sound

sections.label: sleep
sections.text:
Feels as if he should fall asleep while walking in the street ;
sleepy from 11 A.M. till evening.

On sitting down he falls asleep ; after diarrhoea.

Stupor in the morning, notwithstanding a good sleep all night ;
more sleepy in afternoon and evening.

Very sleepy, but cannot fall asleep.

During sleep a sensation as if he would have a headache when
awaking in the morning.

Dreams of danger, especially, of danger on the water, with burn-
ing of hands and feet. See 26.

On awaking in the morning, sensation as if the head were
swollen.
^^ Time. Morning : dullness in forehead ; nose stopped up ; nau-
sea; pain in r. groin; pulse rises; pain in- arm; throbbing
through body ; hip-joint < ; pain back of shoulder.

4am.: coryza loose.

6 A.M. : pains in bowels and diarrhoea.

7 a.m.: catamenia appeared.
9 A.M. to 2 P.M. : headache.
11 A.M. : excoriating coryza.

Forenoon : glow over brow < ; desire for alcoholic drinks ; sore

throat worse.
Noon : hot eructations.
1 P.M. : violent itching tip of nose.
Afternoon : glow over brow better.
4 P.M. : cutting pain in cardiac region.

8 P.M. : violent sneezing, with running of nose.

Evening : coryza gone ; urine hot ; pain in 1. groin ; pain in

sections.label: head
sections.text:
8 to 11 P.M.: pulse falls; breathing difficult.
Night : fullness, with coryza ; red rash on abdomen ; itching
of feet worse.
^^ Temperature and "Weather. Hot washing : itching in anus
better.
Burning feet : holding out of bed >• ; from least cover worse.
Cold bathing : relieves itching in face.
^^ Chill. Fever. S.weat. Chilliness on occiput, neck and chest.
Cold hands and hot body, forenoon.
Burning on hands and feet during sleep at night.

ARSENICUM METALLICUM. 136

I I Throbbing through the whole body, mornings, most in hip-
joint, under breast-bone and in the navel.
^^ Attacks. Symptoms recur every two weeks.

Coryza returns 21st day.

Attacks come suddenly and end slowly, or vieeverna. 6 Coryza.
*^ Locality and Direction. Right : pterygium ; pain in lower
jaw ; throat < ; liver sore ; painful varices side of anus ;
painful swelling in groin ; corona glandis sore ; stitches in
mamma; numbness and lameness in lumbar region; pain
back of shoulder ; pain in arm ; hip-joint lame ; pulsation
in hip-joint.

Right to left : swollen gums ; soreness of under lip.

Left : glow over brow ; pain in inner head ; pulsation in abdo-
men ; stitch in mamma; pain in heart region; twitching in
lower jaw; ulcer on lower lip.

Above downwards : pain in head; splenic pain; pain in mamma;
pain in hip.

Below upwards : pulsation in heel.

Diagonally : stitch pain from liver.
*^ Sensations. As if brain were too large.

As if water was gushing forward in head.

As if swollen : the head, eyelid, hands and fingers.

As if skin were immovably tense.

Cutting : in abdomen ; through heart.

Lancinating : in bowels. \

Shooting : in abdomen.

Stitches : from liver to sternum ; in r. mamma ; under shoul-
derblade ; in 1. mamma about an inch behind nipple ; in
heart; behind the shoulder-blade; in 1. arm.

Stinging : in face.

Burning : in face ; in abdomen ; in rectum ; of the prepuce ;
in chancres ; in uterus and vagina ; of feet.

Scalded feeling : of gums.

Sore pain : in region of liver.

Soreness: of scalp; of upper lid; in 1. arm.

Pressure: in region of stomach.

As if wrenched: right arm.

Throbbing : in body, with headache ; ^n groin ; under the
sternum; in r. hip-joint; from heel up to hips.

Twitching: in 1. lower law.

Undefined pain : in 1. side of head, to ear and eye ; in eyes ;
in facial bones; in ears; in r. lower jaw down into throat
and neck ; in region of spleen to groin ; in breast to spleen ;
in swelling in groin ; in groins ; in 1. mamma; in r. side of
chest near nipple ; in region of heart ; in muscles of 1. chest ;
in spine between shoulders ; in shoulders ; in r. arm above
elbow ; in 1. hip.

Heaviness : in eyes ; in arms and hands.

137 ARSENICUM METALLICUM.

Lameness : in r. hip-joint.

Numbness : on r. occiput ; on 1. vertex ; from nose to forehead,
and over vertex ; in region of eyebrows ; below ears ; from
hip-joint to pubic region ; in r. lumbar region.

Crawlino; : on end of back.

Glowing : on a small spot over 1. brow.

Dryness : in r. knee-joint.

Itching: on forehead; on tip of nose ; in face; an inch above
navel ; in anus, perineum and scrotum ; in groin and down
to knee ; on glans penis ; on the mammge ; in front of throat ;
in neck ; in olecranon.
** Tissues. Emaciation : for weeks.

In two weeks lost half a pound ; another in the same time one
pound.

Lost within a week 3, 4 pounds, a girl, set. 10.
*® Touch. Passive Motion. Injuries. Touch : heat in uterus
and vagina <C ', pain from cheek-bones into r. eye.

Pinching : itching allayed. See 4.

Pulling hair : scalp sore.

Rubbing : itching in anus worse.

Pressing or squeezing : itching better.

Scratching : itching worse.
*® Skin. Itching : now here, then there, has to pinch the spot.

Itching : with swelling in face, on head, neck and mamma ;
on forearm ; later, on ankles of both feet.

Skin peels off in small scales.

Bluish-red eruption on abdomen ; rash, and red smooth spots.

Red spots over the whole body. Cured by JSfatr. carh.

Small furuncles in the face for three months.

Small red pimples over the whole body, without much itching,
appear after 3, 4 months, and last several weeks. Sec-
ondary syphilis.
^^ Relationship. Most similar to its near relative : Arsen. alb.

Useful in pterygium after failure of Nux vom. and Spigel.

Bellad. relieved angina faucium.

Compare: lodium^ Mercur., and JVatr. carh. in syphilis; l^ux
vom. (drowsy after sound sleep) ; Hhus tox. (pain in back,
hips, etc.) ; Sulphur (pulse).

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM FLAYUM. 188

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM FLAVUM.

Orpiment. AsS^.

Hahnemann published in his Materia Medica a single short proving, by
Langhammer; one of the most truthworthy provers. Some reports of ef-
fects by the OLl School physicians are given in Allen's Encyclopaedia, I,
556; also a symptom observed by Hencke.

^ Mind. Intense and torturing anxiety and apprehension ; great-
est apprehension after a swoon.
Mind clearer than previously.
^ Sensorium. When walking he felt as if dancing up and down,
as if he must fly.
Great weakness in the head.
Vanishing of thought. See 9.
^ Inner Head. Throbbing stitches in the right frontal region.
Headache in middle of forehead, drawing and stinging.
Pain deep in, in left forehead, situated back of inner corner of
eye and higher than the eyebrow ; it extends towards the
left and deeper in, like a curve or drawn bow-string.
After drinking beer pain above the occiput in both sides ; vio-
lent pressure in two places, right and left side symmetrical.
Nausea, with neuralgic pains about the head, when rising ;

> while lying down.
Headache, nausea and vomiting of a whitish fluid ; extremities

covered with cold sweat.
1 Serous apoplexy.
* Outer Head. External needle-like stitches in right frontal re-
gion.
Tearing pain from parietal to frontal region.
On stroking the hair on occiput, a tensive feeling behind the
right ear, as if something stuck there and pressed it forward.
^ Sight and Eyes. Grum in the canthi.

® Hearing and Ears. Tensive feeling behind right ear on strok-
ing the hair.
^ Face. Forehead cold.
^^ Teeth and Gums. Teeth pain as if loose, when chewing the

food.
" Taste, Speech, Tongue. Taste bitter.

Tongue : furred, yellow-white ; stiff", immovable ; swollen ;
later dry, with disgust for all nourishment.
^^ Inner Mouth. Mouth and throat dry.

Pustules or herpetic ulcers, of a phagadenic character.

139 ARSENICUM SULPHUEATUM FLAVUM.

^^ Appetite. Loss of appetite.

^^ Nausea and Vomiting. Nausea at noon after a meal ; and
vomiting, witli pain in the stomach and abdomen ; diarrhoea
and thirst.
Violent, persistent vomiting.
After vomiting oifensive bile, was relieved.
^^ Stomach. Cramp in stomach, with fainting, colic, vomiting,
diarrhoea, d Gangrene of the bowels.
Burning and gnawing in stomach, with vomiting and diarrhoea.
Indigestion.
^^ Abdomen. Violent griping, with convulsions.

Violent colic, as from a cold, morning on awaking.
Abdomen puffed ; blue spots in fundus of stomach ; reddish-
brown erosions.
End of ileum more inflamed than the duodenum.
Sensation as if diarrhoea would set in. See 9.
^^ Rectum and Stool. Stools like water, green and slimy, and
terribly offensive.
Diarrhoea daily at 8 a.m. and several times during the day, but

not at night.
Diarrhoea with colic and backache and tenesmus.
^^ Male Sexual Organs. Gonorrhoea, with terrible pains ; dis-
charge copious, yellow, constant; burning day and night,
along the entire urethra, with restlessness.
Seminal emissions. See 37.
2^ Voice and Larynx. I Laryngeal phthisis. ^In a drunkard.
^ Respiration. Respiration difficult.

B Indescribably unpleasant feeling, with oppression ; everything
feels too tight, worse about the hypochondria; ending in
sweat.
^^ Cough. Cough from tickling in throat ; with pain in left side ;
soreness on chest ; with heat in left chest and face, circum-
scribed red cheeks.
Cough with soreness in chest and between shoulders.
Catarrhal cough with pains in chest and rattling.
^^ Inner Chest and Lungs. Lungs overfilled with blood.

Needle-like stitches from within out in right side of chest.
^^ Heart, Pulse and Circulation. Yellow serum in pericardium.
Pulse: frequent, hard, then small and thready; slow, sup-
pressed, quick, and scarcely perceptible.
^^ Neck and Back. Backache confining him to bed; (with caries
of the sternum and cough. Sulphur partly cured the caries,
Psorin. the cough, and Arsen. sulj>h. the backache and re-
maining caries).
Pain in lumbar vertebrae when moving.
^^ Upper Limbs. Eruption on outer side of left wrist ; also on in-
ner side, after Sulphur. {Sulphur did not cure, Arsen.
sulph. did).

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM FLAVUM. 140

^^ Lower Limbs. Pain in left knee, with chronic asthma.

Knees pain, and totter.

Pain above the left ankle-bone.

Feet burn.
^* Limbs in General. Severe pain, now in the toes, now in the

shoulders ; now here, now there, ending with sweat.
^^ Rest. Position. Motion. Children are slow in learning to
walk.

Worse when rising: neuralgic pains about head.

Better lying down : neuralgia in head.

When moving : pain in lumbar vertebrae.
^® Nerves. General debility.

Nerves severely affected.

Annoying twitching of thirty years' duration.

Spasms, colic, vomiting, diarrhoea, heat and thirst next day.

Faints after a convulsion.

General feeling of lameness, staggering, trembling ; all strength
is gone.

I Limbs paralyzed; has itch and dropsy.
^^ Sleep. Starting in sleep, also in falling asleep ; as if he would
fall out of bed.

Restless at night, excited ; dreams with seminal emissions.
^^ Time. At 8 a.m. : daily diarrhoea.

At noon : nausea after a meal, etc. See 16.
^^ Temperature and Weather. Relieved by steam or hot water.
*" Fever. Chronic intermittent fever, worse every afternoon and
evening ; terrible heat at night.

Hectic without thirst.
*^ Sensations. Pain in teeth as if loose.

Everything feels too tight about the hypochondria.

Needle-like stitches : in r. frontal region.

Throbbing stitches : in r. frontal region.

Terrible pains : with gonorrhoea.

Tearing pain : from parietal to frontal region.

Drawing : and stinging in middle of forehead.

Griping : in abdomen.

Burning : in stomach ; along entire urethra ; in feet.

Neuralgic pain : about head.

Soreness : on chest ; between shoulders.

Pressure : above occiput, r. and 1. side.

Gnawing : in stomach.

Cramp : in stomach.

Tensive feeling : behind r. ear.

Undefined pain : deep in 1. forehead ; in stomach and abdomen :
in 1. side with cough; in shoulders; in 1. knee; above 1.
ankle-bone ; in toes.

Tickling : in throat, causing cough.

Heat : in 1. chest and face.

141 ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM FLAVUM.

^* Tissues. I Pain in the joints. ^Rheumatism.

Emaciated children.
*^ Skin. Icterus.

Chafing about the genitals and behind the ears, in children.

Skin scaly, blackish.

Skin itching, dry, cracked; rhagades ; itch.
^^ Stages of Life, Constitution. ■ Case of caries of sternum
with cough and backache of 15 years' standing. See 31.

I A drunkard with phthisis laryngea.
*^ Relationship. Similar to Calc. carb.: (children are slow in
learning to walk).

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM. 142

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM.

Realgar. As^S^-

Introduced and proved by Dr. Neidhard and his class in 1852 ; also
proved by Patrick McHamara, Raymond, Howard, Preston and others.

^ Mind. Had an effect on his mind in making him crosser, and
also to act with more energy ; 4th day.

* Sensorium. Increased heat of the head and face, with a feel-

ing of fullness, and heavy, dull sensation in head.

Falls in a deep swoon, with swelling of the face ; from inhala-
tion.
^ Inner Head. Waking often with a dull pain in forehead over
eyes, extending over top of head nearly to organ of self-
esteem.

Heavy pain in forehead.

After three hours a general malaise, pain across the forehead,
and chilly pain, lasted till he went to bed ; left him in the
night durirjg sleep.

Severe continued pain extending deep into brain in r. frontal
region, also to r. ear ; very much < by stooping and exer-
cise; > by application of cold; 5 p.m.

Dull pain in r. frontal region, which increased in severity, and
became a sharp throbbing and shooting pain, extending to
occiput on r. side; < by motion and stooping ; 4 p.m.

Headache similar to that of 2d day, with the addition that the
pains were in the whole frontal region, but most severe in
the right.

Pain commencing in back of head below philoprogenitiveness,
and extending thence around the sides of the head ; some-
times dull and sometimes sharp ; 7 till 11 a.m.

* Outer Head. Heat of the head and face.

® Hearing and Ears. Sensation of fullness and pressing out-
wards in r. ear.

Snapping sound in ear corresponding to pulsation of temporal
artery.

Scarlet redness and burning of upper half of 1. ear, with ting-
ling similar to that produced by a frost bite.

The ear feels hot to the touch to himself and others.

A very unpleasant, quick beating, extending deep into 1. ear,
with pain and scarlet redness and heat of upper half of ear ;
ear feels full, with pressing outwards.

143 ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM.

^ Smell and Nose. Sneezing occasionally, with a thin white dis-
charge from both nostrils.

Sensation as if corjza was about to set in ; sneezed several
times during day, with tingling in r. nostril.

Free discharge from nostrils, thin and white.
" Face. Has a better expression of countenance than before ; used
to look dull, but now looks brighter.

Sensible pulsation of arteries of r. side of face and head.
" Tongue. Bitter taste in mouth on waking.
^^ Inner Mouth. Mucous membrane of mouth and throat much
inflamed ; also lips and 1. side of tongue ; 1. eje (conjunctiva)
much inflamed and puff"ed out.
^^ Palate and Throat. Inflammation of throat with deep red-
ness, occasional pains and a raw feeling.

Enlargement of r. tonsil.

At times intolerable itching in throat, inducing a short, dry,
expulsive cough.
" Appetite, Thirst, Desires, Aversions. No inclination for
supper.

Excessive thirst, continued for three days.

During this day and the next had very little appetite, and at
times rather an aversion to food, otherwise well.
^^ Eating and Drinking. An hour after breakfast, fullness and
weight at pit of stomach, low spirited, and no disposition to
talk all day.

Ate but little at dinner time ; disagreeable feeling in stomach
till 8 P.M., Avhen a burning sensation set in, which increased
rapidly, and from 10 o'clock till 9 in the morning was so in-
tense as to deprive him almost of his breath ; relief in no po-
sition ; feet and hands cold; trembling of the whole body ;
twitching and jerking of lower extremities; anxiety, fear of
death ; stomach felt as if he had coals of fire in it ; pain ex-
tended from cardiac extremity to 1. hypochondriac region ;
cold drinks increased the burning in stomach ; pulse de-
pressed and thread-like ; face pale and livid ; could not bear
least pressure on region of stomach.

Sharp cutting pains in 1. abdominal region after each meal ;
aggravated when walking, relieved by firm pressure with
hand upon the aff"ected part.

After meals indisposed for mental or physical exertion.
^® Nausea. Nausea in the afternoon.

^^ Scrobiculum and Stomach. Heavy sensation and gnawing
in region of stomach.

Dull, heavy pain, extending from pit of stomach to back, with
a sensation of a weight in stomach.

Very weak, much soreness over whole extent of stomach.

In evening, on returning home, felt symptoms of derangement

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM. 144

of stomach; great weakness and trembling all over; had
walked rather more than usual during the day.

^^ Hypochondria. Large bluish spots over epigastric region, ab-
domen and thighs.

^^ Abdomen. During afternoon dull pains in bowels, with feeling
of fullness extending across into the hypogastric region.
Most violent colic with terrible vomiting.
In the smaller intestines round ulcers with blackish fundus.

^*' Kectum and Stool. A loose, small evacuation during day at
an unusual hour ; another one in evening.
Had a discharge from rectum of pure bile ; urine saffron-color.
■ Diarrhoea of two months' standing; yellow, mushy stools in
the morning early, after getting up, and in the evening be-
fore going to bed ; a kind of tenesmus in anus is constant.

^^ Male Sexual Organs. Slight drawing pain for a short time in
1. spermatic cord.

2^ Voice and Larynx. Hoarseness, with accumulation of tough,
tenacious mucus in throat.

^^ Inner Chest and Lungs. Awakes at 5 a.m. with a sharp
cutting pain, commencing between the cartilages of the fifth
and sixth ribs, extending inwards and upwards deep into
the chest ; the pain was so sharp that it did not admit of the
slightest motion; was obliged to suspend respiration as much
as possible.

^^ Heart, Pulse and Circulation. Occasional sharp pains,
which appear to affect the base of the heart, impeding respi-
ration.

^^ Neck and Back. After rising in the morning, a heavy, press-
ing pain, extending from the point of the os coccygis to the
anus ; soreness of the os coccygis ; the pain in the anus is
increased by efforts to evacuate the bowels and when passing
water ; bearing down would produce a heavy, sickening sen-
sation.

^^ Upper Limbs. Rheumatism from r. shoulder down the arm, as
if in the bone ; paralysis for three days.
Pain in bones of 1. upper arm, more towards morning, when he

wakes up.
Coldness of the hands.

Slight numbness of forearms and hands, with heaviness ; drop-
ped things.

^* Lower Limbs. Considerable pain in r. hip, with lameness in
leg.
Severe pain affecting the inferior third of the tibia of the left
leg ; commences at the lower point of the malleolus internus,
and extends upwards in the shaft of the bone ; momentarily
relieved by changing the position of the foot and by friction
with the hand.

145 ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM.

Numbness and prickling affecting inner side of calf of r. leg,
the heel, outer side of foot and little toe.

Violent itching of third toe of 1. foot, producing occasional
spasms of muscles of the foot and leg.

About 1 P.M. the thighs and legs itched; worse after scratch-
ing.; seemed to leave in about two hours, and about 5 o'clock
the anterior muscles of thighs felt sore in descending the
stairs ; about 9 o'clock legs and thighs commenced to itch
again.
^^ Rest. Position, Motion. Rest : pain in chest better.

Walking : pain in abdomen worse.

Motion : pain in chest worse.

Motion and friction : pain in tibia better.

Stooping and exercise : pain in frontal region worse.
36 Jferves. Convulsions, with abdomen puffed up ; offensive, bili-
ous diarrhoea, slimy vomit ; death in 4 to 6 days ; a child.

General heaviness of the whole body, sleeps longer, and is more
difficult to rouse.
^^ Sleep. Did not sleep so sound as usual, very restless, with many
dreams.

Was very sleepy before taking the medicine, but afterwards felt
no desire to sleep, was very restless through the night, wak-
ing up often with a dull pain in head.

All the symptoms develop more in the night ; very vivid dreams
all night.
^^ Time. Morning : diarrhoea ; bone pains in arm.

5 A.M. : pain between fifth and sixth ribs.

7 to 11 A.M. : pain in head.
Afternoon : pain in bowels.

1 P.M. : thighs and legs itched.

5 P.M. : pain frontal region ; thighs sore.

Evening : stomach weak ; unusual stool.

8 P.M. : disagreeable feeling in stomach.

9 P.M. : thighs itch.

10 P.M. to 9 A.M. : stomach burning intensely.
Night : pain in head ; dreams ; all symptoms.

^^ Temperature and Weather, Cold : pain frontal region better.
*" Chill, Fever. Sweat. Towards night felt very cold and
chilly, even before hot stove, lasted for three or four hours.
Heat and thirst ; loss of appetite ; frequent vomiting ; a child.
^^ Locality and Direction. Right : pain frontal region ; full-
ness in ear ; tingling in ear ; pulsation in arteries ; tonsil
enlarged ; rheumatism in shoulder ; pain in hip ; numbness
in leg ; throbbing and shooting in head.
Left : ear painful ; eye inflamed ; pain in spermatic cord ; bone-
pains in arms; pain in tibia; third toe itches.
Above downwards : rheumatism in shoulder.
Below upwards : pain in chest ; pain in tibia.

VOL. II. — 10.

ARSENICUM SULPHURATUM RUBRUM. 146

*^ Sensations. As if he had coals of fire in stomach.

Cutting : in 1. abdominal region ; between cartilages of fifth
and sixth ribs.

Shooting ; in r. side of head.

Sharp pain : at base of heart.

Pressing pain : from point of os coccygis to anus.

Drawing : in 1. spermatic cord.

Gnawing: in region of stomach.

Throbbing : in r. side of head.

Burning : of ear ; in stomach.

Soreness : of os coccygis ; of anterior muscles of thighs.

Raw feeling : in throat.

Rheumatic pain : in r. arm.

Heavy pain : in forehead ; in stomach ; from point of os coccy-
gis to anus.

Dull pain : in forehead, over eyes, to top of head ; in r. frontal
region ; from pit of stomach to back ; in bowels.

Undefined pain : across forehead ; deep into brain ; in back of
head ; in bones of 1. arm ; inferior third of 1. tibia.

Fullness : in head ; in r. ear ; at pit of stomach.

Heaviness : in stomach.

Tingling : in ear ; in r. nostril.

Numbness: of forearms and hands; in r. calf; in foot.

Heat : of head ; in face ; in ear.

Itching : in throat ; of third toe of 1. foot ; of thighs and legs.
** Tissues. All the joints remain immovable after the recovery
from the poison.

Rheumatic symptoms first 24 hours after taking the medicine
in the morning.

*^ Touch. Passive Motion. Injuries. Touch : ear feels hot.
Pressure : stomach worse.
Firm pressure : pains in abdomen better.
Scratching : itching thigh worse.
*^ Stages of Life, Constitution. Young man, set. 18 ; head-
ache in forehead and back of head, with vertigo and empty
feeling in region of heart.

14T ARTEMISIA VULGARIS.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Sensation of heaviness in the eyes. — Eyelids slightly inflamed
and swollen (first day), (1st potency). — Eyes so painful that he cannot
read much.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Fluent coryza. — Scalding water runs from the nose, excoriating
the nostrils (fifth day), (30th potency). — The coryza returns in fifteen days
with heat in the face and hoarseness, lasting three days, when it became
accompanied with angina faucium, for which Bell.TM, one dose was success-
fully administered.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Itching and burning in the lower part of the face, as if an
eruption would break out (fourth day), (30th potency). — [20.] Face feels
as if bloated (third day),(lst potency). — Bloated face (third day), (1st
potency). — -Itching all over the face, which can only be relieved by pinch-
ing the skin (for some days). — Burning, itching, stinging in the face, with
swelling ; skin feels as if stiff, relieved by bathing the face with cold water ;
later, desquamation in small scales. — The itching is relieved by pressing,
but not by scratching.

JKouth. — Ulcer on the right side of inner under lip (first day), (3d
potency).^ — Ulcer sore when touched with the tongue (first to second day),
(3d potency). — Ulcer on the left inner side of the under lip (first day),
(3d potency).— Dry mouth. — Tongue coated white, covered with mucus
(twelfth day), (1st potency). — [30.] Tongue coated white, showing the im-

ARSENICUM METALLICUM. 555

print of the teeth on the edges (third day), (30th potency). — Gums swollen
and painful to the touch (first day), (1st potency).— Gums swollen and
feeling as if scalded, with accumulation of water in the mouth ; aversion
to wines and liquors.

Stoma cJl.—l^iinsea, (third day), (1st potency). — Hot eructations as
of bile (third day), (1st potency).

Abdomen, — Bloated abdomen (first to third day), (1st potency). —
Tension and sensation of swelling in the abdomen (third day), (1st
potency). — Pulsation in the umbilicus. — Numbness and sensation of
paralysis in the right lumbar region, extending from the vertebr88 to the
crest of the ilium (first day), (30th potency). — Lumbago. — [40.] Varices
on the right side of the anus, painful after stool (not bleeding), (twelfth
day), (1st potency). — Varices bleed a little (fourth day), (30th potency).
— Varices feel only sore, but neither pain after stool nor bleed (sixteenth
day), (30th potency). — After awaking in the morning at 6 o'clock, dis-
tressing, lancinating, griping pain in the bowels ; afterwards, one sharp,
burning, watery stool, relieving the abdominal pain, but leaving much de-
bility ; he falls asleep sitting on a chair, and has no appetite ; pulse 60,
much fuller than in health (second day), (1st potency). — Constipated
(sixteenth day), (80th potency). — Itching in the right groin extending
down to the knee (twelfth day), (30th potency). — In the right groin a
painful swelling, worse when extending the leg ; pain goes up to the hip'
and continues for a long time. In the same place where this painful swell-
ing appears, a bubo suppurated twenty-four years ago.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Red sandy sediment in the urine (third day), (30th potency).
— Offensive sweat on the genitals (for some weeks).

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Pulsation under the sternum (first day), (30th potency). —
[50.] Slight pains in the left side of the chest in the region of the heart
(second day), (30th potency). — Pain in the muscle of the left chest (second
day), (30th potency). — Hoarseness with coryza (twenty-first day), (30th
potency).

Upper Extremities. — Sensation of swelling of hands and fingers
(third day), (1st potency). — Hands and fingers feel stiff; they feel as if
they could not be closed (third to ninth day), (1st potency). — Cracking of
all the finger-joints (second to fourteenth day), (1st potency). — Dry heat
in the palms of the hands. — A scab which had been on the first joint of the
third finger of the left hand for twenty years, healed entirely ; whereas,
formerly, when the scab had been torn off, it left a spot of a liver color,
and a new scab soon formed,".

Lower Extremities. — Sensation of lameness in the right hip-joint
(second day), (3d potency). — Sensation as if he could not use the limb ; but
he can walk well enough after he has been on his feet a short time (second
day), (3d potency). — [60.] Pulsation in the right hip-joint, worse in the
morning, better in the evenings (second day), (3d potency). — Deepseated
numbness in the right hip-joint (first day), (30th potency). — Sensation of
paralysis in the right hip-joint, extending to the pubic symphysis down in-
side of the thigh to the knee. — Pulsation in the right anterior tibial artery
at the superior extremity of its inferior third (first day), (30th potency). —
Sensation of dryness in the right knee-joint (fourth day), (3d potency). —
Feet burning hot, feel as if bloated (first day), (1st potency). — Feet burning
hot, without the least moisture (second day), (30th potency). — *Feet, usually
icy cold, have become warm and sweat much. — Feet burning more at night ;

556 ARSENICUM SULFURATUM FLAVUM.

he has to hold them out of bed ; cannot have the least cover on them (first
to fourteenth day), (1st and 3d potency).

Geneval Symptoms.— Dehility; weariness; general prostration of
strength. — [70.] Emaciation.- — ^Pulsation all over the body. — The symptoms
appear first on the right and then on the left side. — Morning exacerbations.
— The symptoms recur again after two weeks. — Aggravation after drinking
a small quantity of brandy, for which he had not the slightest desire.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Unusually sound sleep at night (first day), (3d potency). —
Irresistible inclination to sleep in the daytime and early in the evening
(second day), (3d potency). — Great drowsiness in the morning after rising,
having had a sound sleep (second day), (30th potency). — Very reluctant
to rise in the morning after a good night's sleep (third day), (3d potency).
— [80.] Feels as if he should tall asleep while walking in the street in the
afternoon (second day), (3d potency). — Stupor in the morning, notwith-
standing a good sleep all night (third day), (30th potency). — Very sleepy
but cannot tall asleep (second day), (30th potency). — During sleep a sensa-
tion as if he would have a headache when awaking in the morning. —
During sleep, dreams of danger, especially of danger on the water (fifth
day), (1st potency). — On awaking in the morning, sensation as if the head
were swollen (first day), (1st potency). — Normal pulse being 55, is ac-
celerated to 68 in the morning (first day), (1st potency). — Normal pulse
being 65, is accelerated to 68 in the morning (second day), (1st potency).
— Normal pulse being 55, is accelerated to 68 in the morning (first day),
(30th potency). — Normal pulse being 55, is accelerated to 68 in the morn-
ing and falls down to 53 in the evening (second day), (3d potency). —
[90.] Normal pulse being 55, is accelerated to 68 in the morning, and
lowered to 43 in the evening (fourth day), (1st potency). — Normal pulse
being 55, is now 72 in the morning, 64 in the evening (fifth day), (1st
potency). — Normal pulse being 55, is now, in the morning, 64, in the
evening 48 (first day), (30th potency). — Pulse after midnight 48, in the
morning, after rising, 68 (third day), (30th potency). — Pulse 64 in the
morning (fourth day), (30th potency). — The pulse continues to rise in the
morning, and to fall in the evening for thirty days longer, without taking
more medicine.

Conditions. — Aggravations. — {Morning), General aggravation. —
Pulsation in right hip. On waking, head feels swollen. {Brandy), Aggra-
vates.— {Laughing), Headache.

Ameliorations. — {Evening), Pulsation in right hip. — {Pinching or
vressing the skin), Itching.
